## What changes, and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. State any checks you skipped and why. For UI changes, include screenshots with synthetic data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant regression coverage or an explanation of why none is needed.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private recordings, model downloads, or unlicensed third-party assets are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the project's AGPL-3.0-only license.
